species.name: Wet wipes
species.common: A small disposable synthetic cloth treated with a cleansing agent, used especially for personal hygiene.

species.name: Drink cans
species.common: Metal containers that are used for storing and selling, e.g. beer or soft drinks

species.name: Tampons
species.common: A feminine hygiene product designed to absorb the menstrual flow or a plug of material used to stop a wound or block an opening in the body and absorb blood or secretions. The tampon applicator should be recorded within this category.
